hints.en: Say you lost your phone on the subway.
Say it's black and a bit small.
Say you lost it around two o'clock.
Say what a relief, and thank them very much.
Thank her formally for inviting you.
Ask if you have to take off your shoes.
Say you think the bulgogi is really delicious.
Say you had a really good time today, and the goodbye for when you are the one leaving.
